title: Gwen personas, model choice, culture residency

claims.text: Gwen becomes a configurable companion: the operator designs personas (style, length, language, prompt) and talks with one, picks the reply model per conversation from what the lobes gateway currently serves, and Gwen holds a residency on Culture chat where she can choose to ask the mesh a question and bring the answer back — with less brevity enforced by fixed prompt text
